_doc: KIN-QUALITY-001 reading fixture (R-quality-reading-surface). Not part of rsi/runtime/ux/journeys.json: it boots the throwaway daemon and fake agent through scripts/journeys-smoke.sh --spec and is the one-command pixel proof for the story's three widths. `[seed] reading` renders long prose plus a 5-row table; a `[seed] slow` follow-up (the smoke script holds it 10 s) is sent, its optimistic bubble is awaited, the reader scrolls away, and the reply lands out of sight — the bubble wait keeps the send's pin-to-bottom from beating the scroll. The 45 s control wait covers a follow-up the throwaway daemon serializes behind the denied seeded approvals; a timeout still fails. The seeded inbox's pending approvals are denied first so the shell's floating card does not cover the table; that overlay is not this story's. The `reading` op observes only; `readingVerdict` and scripts/quality_001_reading_test.py in scripts/check.sh decide.
